note: Only normalized Fake/Stripe facts: no raw body, contact data, secret or provider metadata. Account, intent and refund identifiers are provider-issued opaque operational identifiers; delivery bindings contain only tenant-scoped foreign keys. Amounts are integer bookkeeping. Raw body digest/reference lives in reliability inbox. Account binding is immutable provisioning authority.

attempt_key.reason: Frozen RMA refund key prevents a retry from creating another financial obligation.

provider_ref.reason: Opaque provider intent reference binds the confirmed refund to its captured payment.

provider_refund_id.reason: Opaque provider refund identity prevents duplicate money posting across deliveries.

journal_id.reason: Permanent journal foreign key proves the single posted refund.

created_at.reason: DB timestamp for permanent refund recovery and reconciliation evidence.
